title: EpiGBS lab protocol
protocol: Homogenize plant material by bead-beating frozen leaf tissue in a 2 mL eppendorf tube with 2-3 mm stainless steel beads.
Store samples with beads in liquid nitrogen.
Place the tubes in a tissuelyzer 24 adapter set block, partially submerged in liquid nitrogen to avoid thawing during sample placement.
Shake for 30 seconds at 30 Hz / 1800 oscillations per minute.
Submerge the tubes in liquid nitrogen after shaking.
Perform a second round of shaking for 30 seconds at 30 Hz / 1800 oscillations per minute.
Isolate DNA from the samples using the Macherey-Nagel Nucleospin Plant II kit.
Perform cell lysis with Cell Lysis Buffer PL1 for 30 minutes.
Filter through the pink nucleospin filter, carefully pipetting the flow-through to a fresh tube without disturbing any pellet.
Centrifuge to remove a small pellet if present.
Select samples with high purity, specifically those having 260/280 and 260/230 ratios of at least 1.8 and 1.5 respectively.
Determine DNA concentration using the Qubit® 2.0 Fluorometric dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Digest 400 ng of genomic DNA overnight at 37°C in a volume of 40 µL containing 1x NEBuffer 3.1, 125 µg BSA and 2 µL / 40 units of PstI.
Following digestion, ligate barcoded adapters to the fragments.
Combine 1200 pg of both forward and reverse barcoded adapters in a 60 µL reaction containing 40 µL gDNA digest, 1x T4 DNA ligase buffer, and 4000K units T4 DNA ligase.
Incubate the ligation mixture for 3 hours at 22°C followed by overnight incubation at 4°C.
Pool samples per species after ligation.
Perform per-species pooling to assess library quality.
Reduce the total library volume by Qiaquick PCR cleanup to 60 µL.
Size select the libraries using a 0.8x Agencourt AMPure XP purification favoring >200 bp DNA fragments and elute in a total volume of 24 µL.
Repair the nick in epiGBS libraries using a 1-hour nick translation reaction at 15°C.
Prepare the nick translation reaction with 18 µL of purified library, 2.5 µL of 10 mM 5-methylcytosine dNTP Mix, 1x NEBuffer 2, and 7.5 units DNA polymerase I in a total volume of 25 µL.
Perform GBS PCR using the epiGBS PCR protocol to check library quality.
Assess the quality of PCR-libraries by analyzing 1 μL on a High Sensitivity DNA chip on a 2100 Bioanalyzer system.

Treat 20 µL of nick-translated library with Bisulfite using the EZ DNA Methylation-Lightning™ Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol: 8 minutes at 98°C, followed by 1 hour at 54°C and up to 20 hours at 4°C.
Perform library amplification per species in four individual 10 µL reactions.
Include 1 µL ssDNA template in each reaction.
Add 5 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart Uracil+ ReadyMix to the reaction.
Use 3 pmol of each illumina PE PCR Primer.
Incubate at 95°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 98°C for 10 s, 65°C for 15 s, and 72°C for 15 s for 18 cycles.
Extend at 72°C for 5 min after the final cycle.
Pool replicate PCR products together.
Quantify pooled PCR products using a Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Assess quality of libraries by analyzing 1 µL on a High Sensitivity DNA chip.
Consider libraries suitable for sequencing if fragments are between 150–400 bp and no adapter dimers are found.
Pool ‘per species’ libraries according to concentration and number of samples in the species pool.
Ensure each individual sample will yield an equal number of clusters on the Illumina flowcell.
Perform a ‘nano run’ on the Illumina MiSeq to quantify per-sample expected relative read count yield.
Based on read counts, pool individual nick-translated digestion-ligations for equal read expectations per individual.
Perform Rapid Run Mode Paired-End sequencing on an Illumina HiSeq2500 sequencer.
Use the HiSeq v4 reagents for the sequencing.
Utilize the latest version of the HiSeq Control Software (v2.2.38) to optimize sequencing of low-diversity libraries.
Conduct the first five cycles of the sequencing run to calculate the color matrix.
Ensure that the barcode design achieves almost perfect balance of the first 5 nucleotides when equal numbers of sequences are obtained per forward read or “A” barcode.
Use reverse read or “B” barcodes consisting of only four nucleotides.
Construct the Csp6I epiGBS libraries as described for PstI epiGBS libraries with modifications.
Prepare restriction digestion reaction using 1x FD buffer and 4 µL / 40 units of Csp6I (ThermoFisher Scientific, FD0214).
Include 2400 pg of both A and B adapters adjusted for the Csp6I sticky end in the ligation reaction.
Use hemi-methylated adapters instead of fully methylated ones used in PstI protocol.
Resynthesize adapter strands incorporating 5mC dNTP’s by nick translation, where all cytosines are replaced with methylated 5mC.
Perform final library amplification for Csp6I to yield 4 - 8 ng / µL product for an epiGBS PCR of 18 cycles.
